text:
Nia: quick sync 1h: pricing experiments for next launch. scope = FAQ tweak, tier-name A/B, and two calc flows (quick slider vs commitment wizard). Need owners and gating decision.
Rahul: for tier names lets test 'Growth / Scale / Enterprise' vs 'Starter / Committed / Enterprise'. my hunch: Growth resonates with startups.
Bea: agree. also propose a micro-FAQ row about 1) seat vs token billing, 2) overage behavior, 3) refunds for dev credits. short copy only.
Carlos: calc UX note: slider quick-estimate (ungated) then a 'Commitment plan' modal that asks email + company size. that preserves lead capture for high intent.
Maya: tracking ask  add utm_source=launch_email and event names: `pricing_quick_open`, `pricing_commitment_submit`. capture props: `tokens_per_month`, `chosen_tier`, `commitment_months`, `intent_score`.
Nia: owners: Rahul -> tier copy + A/B setup; Bea -> FAQ copy; Carlos -> calc code + gating; Maya -> analytics and dashboard. sound right?
Rahul: yup. I9ll prepare two header copies and 2 small hero mockups (CTA variants: "Estimate" vs "Get commitment quote").
Bea: FAQ draft snippet: "How are overages calculated? We bill in 1k token increments, rounding up. Discounts apply to committed monthly spends." will expand.
Carlos: quick-dev note: our calc will output JSON: `{"estimate_usd": number, "monthly_tokens": number, "intent_score": number}`. can map directly to HubSpot fields.
Maya: for routing: intent_score >= .75 & webinar_signed -> AE; intent_score >= .75 & no webinar -> SDR high-touch; .4-.75 -> SDR nurture; <.4 -> marketing drip. I'll make a mapping table in the sheet.
Nia: gating decision? Carlos suggested email-only on commitment modal. any objections?
Rahul: fine with gating for commitment. let's add a one-click 'save for later' email capture in slider flow (optional).
Bea: micro-FAQ location: under calc and in pricing FAQ anchor. Also let's add short clarifier on discounts applying to tokens not model multipliers.
Carlos: dev timeline: I can push quick slider by Tue EOD, modal + gating Wed morning. need final copy by Tue noon.
Maya: will wire up events and create dashboards. ETA Wed midday for first dashboards.
OpsBot: Release plan: staging deploy for pricing micro-updates scheduled 2024-06-06T02:00:00Z. Monitor ops-alerts channel.
Nia: webinar idea: 30-min "reading unit economics" demo + Q&A. Miguel (not in thread) can join for bench slides. want to target developer leads.
Rahul: webinar CTA will be on both the blog and calc modal. add UTM utm_campaign=pricing_launch_v2.
Bea: also recommend a 3-question microsurvey after calc to improve the funnel: use-case, team size, expected monthly tokens. short buttons.
Carlos: will surface microsurvey results as props: `use_case`, `team_size_bracket`.
Maya: goal benchmarks: calc_open -> webinar_reg conversion 12%; webinar_attend -> trial_start 8%.
Nia: perfect. I'll collate action items and send invite for 1pm planning tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
